title: Behavior Skills ClaudeMD boosts Claude accuracy and cuts #claudemd #aibreakthrough #aidevelopment
description: Behavior Skills ClaudeMD improved Claude’s performance by resolving common user issues such as over-engineering simple tasks, ignoring instructions, premature task completion, and hallucinating fake APIs. This single GitHub repository, highly starred with 170,000 stars, integrates seamlessly to enhance Claude's functionality and reliability. By addressing these persistent problems, Behavior Skills ClaudeMD enables developers and users to deploy Claude with greater confidence and efficiency. Its popularity highlights the community’s demand for more practical and obedient AI behavior, reducing friction in AI integration workflows. The implementation of Behavior Skills ClaudeMD marks a significant contribution to AI usability, streamlining task management and minimizing errors that hinder user experience.
